matching_rules: Campaign matches clear straight lines of three or more and never create special pieces (Cradle of Rome rules). Chains take a hit before a plaque can clear. One unlocked bonus chip family can charge on a board, and each unlocked socket stores up to one use.

campaign_pieces.states: One authored sprite per match kind. Selection, hints, chains, press and motion use the existing board overlays and transforms.
campaign_pieces.registration: Crop revised pieces from their named boxes, then fill remaining base sprites from the original columns and row bands. Trim the transparent exterior, fit and center each object.

bonus_gems.generator: prepare_bonus_gems.py maps one painted base to a circle and generates all five button states with the existing standalone gems
bonus_gems.registration: Fit the standalone gems to 112 px for the board and 84 px for the buttons, with a smaller Hammer to clear the hex and inset edges. Map the source plate alpha contour to a 57 px radius, and use a 47 px inset radius for the state recipes. Center button glyphs by visible alpha, or by visible bounds for the Hammer, and fit them inside a 41 px radius. All atlas cells are 128 px.

dynamite.effect: Hit the selected cell and its six neighbors

lightning.effect: Hit the selected row and additional cells up to twenty

star.effect: Hit every piece of the chosen kind

star-ii.effect: Hit the chosen kind through one layer of chain or ice

plus.effect: Add a quarter charge to each other unlocked slot

plus-ii.effect: Add half a charge to each other unlocked slot

toolbar.rank_label: Level II overlays a small II badge on its generated button.

retired_tool_buttons.retired: Square pickaxe, dynamite and sunburst buttons from before the bonus toolbar; every board now has bonus slots, so they are no longer registered or packed. The authored sheet stays as provenance.
